name: Neu-Soft
descriptionForPrompt: permukaan biru es yang lembut, bentuk membulat, bayangan halus, satu aksen biru tegas, komposisi lapang dan tenang
sampleCode: const k = s.spring(0, "snappy"); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy, scale: s.lerp(0.72, 1, k), rotate: s.wave(0.35, 0.025) }, () => { s.circle(0, 0, 150 * s.p, { fill: s.c.blue, alpha: 0.18 }); s.rect(-120, -90, 240, 180, { r: 28, fill: s.c.paper }); s.asset("spark", 150, -110, { size: 40, color: s.c.yellow, draw: k, rotate: s.wave(0.3, 0.08) }); s.words("Ide jadi nyata", 0, 150, { size: 42, color: s.c.ink, mode: "rise", start: 0.15 }); }); s.sfx("pop", 0.1, 0.6);

name: Modern Flat
descriptionForPrompt: ilustrasi flat geometris, warna solid, garis tegas, ruang putih lega, satu objek fokus di tengah
sampleCode: const k = s.at(0, 0.45); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy, scale: 0.9 + 0.1 * k }, () => { s.rect(-180, -220, 360, 440, { r: 24, fill: s.c.white, stroke: s.c.ink, width: 5 }); s.circle(-60, -110, 46, { fill: s.c.red }); s.rect(-120, 10, 240, 28, { r: 14, fill: s.c.ink, draw: k }); s.rect(-120, 60, 180, 22, { r: 11, fill: s.c.teal, draw: k }); s.words("Lebih sederhana", 0, 230, { size: 36, color: s.c.ink, mode: "slide", start: 0.25 }); }); s.sfx("tick", 0.2, 0.4);

name: Papan Tulis
descriptionForPrompt: gambar tangan di atas kertas, garis tinta sedikit bergetar, arsiran ringan, nuansa catatan personal
sampleCode: const k = s.spring(0, "smooth"); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy + 20, rotate: -0.02 }, () => { s.rect(-220, -260, 440, 520, { r: 18, fill: s.c.paper, stroke: s.c.ink, width: 3, wobble: 1 }); s.line(-180, -160, 180, -160, { stroke: s.c.ink, width: 3, draw: k, wobble: 1 }); s.words("Catat idemu", 0, -80, { size: 44, color: s.c.ink, mode: "fade", start: 0.2 }); s.check(-120, 40, 46, { stroke: s.c.green, width: 5, draw: k }); s.line(-60, 40, 150, 40, { stroke: s.c.ink, width: 3, draw: k }); }); s.sfx("type", 0.15, 0.5);

name: Kertas Gunting
descriptionForPrompt: bentuk kertas gunting berlapis, tepi sedikit kasar, warna ceria, bayangan potongan yang tegas
sampleCode: const k = s.pop(0, 0.55); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy, rotate: s.wave(0.25, 0.04) }, () => { s.shape([[-170, -140], [0, -220], [170, -140], [140, 150], [0, 210], [-140, 150]], { fill: s.c.yellow, stroke: s.c.ink, width: 4, draw: k }); s.circle(0, -30, 52, { fill: s.c.red }); s.words("Potong jadi cerita", 0, 210, { size: 34, color: s.c.ink, mode: "pop", start: 0.2 }); }); s.sfx("swish", 0.2, 0.5);

name: Futuristik Data
descriptionForPrompt: latar gelap, garis data bercahaya, grid tipis, biru dan teal neon, kesan presisi dan teknologi
sampleCode: const k = s.spring(0, "heavy"); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy }, () => { for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) { const h = 40 + 120 * s.rand(i); s.rect(-200 + i * 68, 120 - h, 44, h, { r: 8, fill: i % 2 ? s.c.teal : s.c.blue, draw: k }); } s.circle(0, -160, 90, { stroke: s.c.blue, width: 4, draw: k }); s.words("Data bicara", 0, 240, { size: 38, color: s.c.white, mode: "rise", start: 0.2 }); }); s.sfx("riser", 0.1, 0.5);

name: Pop Ceria
descriptionForPrompt: warna primer cerah, bentuk bulat besar, gerakan memantul, komposisi simetris yang ramai tapi rapi
sampleCode: const k = s.spring(0, "bouncy"); const colors = [s.c.red, s.c.yellow, s.c.green, s.c.blue]; s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy }, () => { colors.forEach((color, i) => { const angle = i * Math.PI / 2 + s.wave(0.2, 0.15); s.circle(Math.cos(angle) * 150, Math.sin(angle) * 150, 54, { fill: color, draw: k }); }); s.circle(0, 0, 96, { fill: s.c.white, stroke: s.c.ink, width: 4, draw: k }); s.asset("star", 0, -180, { size: 46, color: s.c.yellow, draw: k }); s.words("Ayo mulai", 0, 250, { size: 40, color: s.c.ink, mode: "pop", start: 0.2 }); }); s.sfx("tada", 0.1, 0.6);

name: Lanskap Tenang
descriptionForPrompt: lanskap minimal bergaya cat air, horizon lapang, warna bumi dan hijau tenang, gerak lambat seperti angin
sampleCode: const k = s.at(0, 0.8); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy }, () => { s.circle(0, -120, 70, { fill: s.c.yellow, alpha: 0.9 }); s.line(-260, 90, 260, 90, { stroke: s.c.teal, width: 6, draw: k }); s.shape([[-260, 90], [-120, -40], [0, 70], [120, -70], [260, 90]], { fill: s.c.green, draw: k }); s.words("Tarik napas", 0, 200, { size: 40, color: s.c.ink, mode: "fade", start: 0.25 }); }); s.sfx("ding", 0.3, 0.4);

name: Tipografi Kinetik
descriptionForPrompt: teks besar sebagai objek utama, kata masuk satu per satu, garis aksen tipis, komposisi editorial yang bersih
sampleCode: const k = s.at(0, 0.5); s.group({ x: s.cx, y: s.cy }, () => { s.words("SATU KATA", 0, -80, { size: 54, color: s.c.ink, mode: "slide", start: 0, gap: 0.05 }); s.words("SATU GERAK", 0, 30, { size: 54, color: s.c.blue, mode: "rise", start: 0.15, gap: 0.05 }); s.rect(-170, 120, 340, 8, { r: 4, fill: s.c.primary, draw: k }); }); s.sfx("whoosh", 0.1, 0.4);
